==Description==
'''Candy Throw''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Solar Eclipse Event#Solar Eclipse Season Pass|Solar Eclipse Season Pass]]. It was created by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 5 in regards to the Event Season Pass, which would cost {{SolarShard|450 Solar Shards}} or {{Robux|175}} at that rank. The total cost to obtain the emote was {{SolarShard|1,475 Solar Shards}} or {{Robux|575}}.

==Trivia==
*As suggested by the inventory description, the candy bucket is the [[Jaxe (Solar Eclipse)|Jaxe]]'s head turned into a candy bucket after its defeat. It has been carved to fit the candy inside.
